name: Shihabiiuc Preloader
author: Shihab Ul Hoque

sections.description:
Shihabiiuc Preloader adds an animated loading screen to your website while the page loads. Once the page is ready, the screen slides away to reveal your content.

There are no settings to configure. Activate the plugin and the preloader appears on every front-end page.

See the live preview

Features

  • Works with any theme
  • No settings, no database entries
  • Lightweight: one small CSS file and one tiny JavaScript file
  • No jQuery or other dependencies
  • Shows above sticky headers, including those from page builders such as Divi
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New and search for “Shihabiiuc Preloader”.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Or install it manually:

  1. Upload the shihabiiuc-preloader folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Do I need to configure anything?

No. The preloader starts working as soon as you activate the plugin.

How do I remove the preloader?

Deactivate the plugin. It does not store anything in your database.
